lines.s1: Welcome to Agent Studio! I'm your guide. Step one: pick a role for your Closer. Sales, support, bookings, or looking after your group. Don't worry, you can change it any time.
lines.s2: Step two: give it a personality! Choose a name your customers will love, then slide to set the tone. Friendly or formal, short or detailed. Watch the sample reply change as you go.
lines.s3: Step three is the big one: teach it! Add the questions customers ask, with your answers. Add your products and prices, and how delivery and payment work. Write it the way you'd say it in chat.
lines.s4: Step four: set the rules. Tell your Closer what it should never say or promise, and when to hand a chat to your team. Like angry customers, refunds, or really big orders.
lines.s5: Last step: test and launch! Tap the test questions, fix any answer that's not quite right, and watch your training score climb. When you're happy, flip it live. You've got this!
lines.d0: Meet Glow Labs! Let's train their AI Closer, Ace, in thirty seconds.
lines.d1: First, a personality. Friendly, short, and just one emoji.
lines.d2: Now teach it, like a new hire. One question, one answer.
lines.d3: A customer asks, and Ace replies with exactly what you taught. In seconds.
lines.d4: Oops, a wrong answer? No stress. Tap fix this answer, and write the right one.
lines.d5: Next time, Ace gets it right. Every single time.
lines.d6: Training score, ninety two. Flip the switch, and Ace is live, selling for you around the clock!
